summary_en: Toyo Electric authorized acquisition of up to 150,000 shares (1.5% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥300 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 15, 2026 and May 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, Toyo Electric Mfg. Co., Ltd. announced a treasury stock acquisition program authorized by the Board of Directors. The company will repurchase up to 150,000 shares, representing 1.5% of outstanding shares (9,724,356 shares as of August 31, 2026), for a total amount not exceeding ¥300 million. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 15, 2026 through May 31, 2027.

The company stated that the objective is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The disclosure notes that acquisitions may be suspended in part or in whole depending on market conditions.
